name: Sabiote (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red at the lower hoist with a yellow castle and white at the upper fly with a red lion, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Sabiote (a black bend on yellow within a bordure of castles and lions).
history: At the proposal of the town council, in December 2016 all inhabitants were invited to a competition of ideas for the creation of the flag of Sabiote, and in March 2017 the municipality inaugurated its flag; the winning design is white and garnet, representing the colours of Castile, with the municipal arms at the centre.

features.role: Sabiote arms — black bend on yellow within a bordure of castles and lions
